## Result

Describe the user-visible or developer-visible behavior after this change.
Use a Conventional Commit PR title such as `feat: add GPX preview` or
`fix: keep the selected routing profile after restart`. The merged title is used
verbatim in the generated release notes.

## Validation

List automated checks and manual platform tests that were run.

## Data and compatibility

Describe changes to project files, SQLite schemas, RN2 behavior, bundled assets,
or platform support. Write "None" when the change has no compatibility impact.
